name: Yug Sikri

experiences.description: Expanded the modernized automation suite in Playwright with TypeScript, writing and migrating 400+ test cases spanning new feature flows and high-value regression scenarios from the legacy Selenium suite. Broadened coverage into REST API testing with Postman, validating 15+ endpoints alongside UI flows to catch integration defects earlier in the cycle. Performed data‑platform QA on Snowflake, validating 10+ data processes across environments to verify financial data pipeline outputs. Ran the full automated regression suite against every production deployment (5+ releases), analyzing failed runs to separate genuine defects from script issues. Reported and tracked 100+ defects in JIRA across the tenure, collaborating with developers across Agile sprint cycles for timely resolution.

Automated 500+ UI regression test cases for a production fintech web application using Selenium WebDriver with C#, significantly reducing manual testing effort. Developed a bulk entity‑onboarding automation script processing 2,000+ entities in a single batch, cutting QA validation time by 60%. Built an automated value‑comparison script to validate data parity across platforms during a migration, reducing manual effort by 70%. Built reusable Page Object Model‑based scripts for core user workflows — login flows, form validations, navigation, and regression scenarios. Maintained and updated test cases against evolving business requirements and new feature releases. Adopted Playwright with TypeScript as the team modernized its suite, writing and executing scripts for new feature flows. Earned conversion to a full‑time role after a two‑round technical and behavioral evaluation.
